profile.headline: Software Engineer at Ford Motor Company
profile.summary:
Specialties: Embedded System Software Engineer.
System software for LINUX, Windows, Kernel, Device driver, firmware, Multimedia driver
Driver for Multimedia Hardware - Camera/ISP, Audio IIS/I2S/, DSP, Video/Display, Hardware Video Codec / H.264 / HEVC, Input-Output Hardware / I2C / SPI, ARM9/11, A8 Core
Boot system, NAND Storage,
I/O Devices (SDIO, MMC/eMMC, USB)
SAMSUNG ARM: S3C2410/2440/2460/6400/6410/C100
WiFi Host Driver & Firmware.

positions.title: Multimedia Team Manager at Semi-conductor Business Unit
positions.description:
As a Mutimedia team manager, I
- led developement of BSP, embedded softwares for Audio, Camera, Hardware Video Codec, Graphics, Overlay and Display, 2D accelerator (Scaler/Rotator)
- led feature phone development project for SAMSUNG Mobile phone team

As an Embedded Software engineer, I
. developed system software, drivers and BSP for SAMSUNG-ARM processor. S3C2410/2440/6400/6410/C100
. Developed Audio firmware and driver, routing of audio stream, Camera driver and video streaming
. Developed Hardware Video Codec driver, Graphics/Overlay and Display driver, 2D accelerator (Scaler/Rotator) driver
. Developed I/O drivers - USB, SDIO, DPRAM 
. developed boot/kernel/driver for LINUX/WinCE/Symbian
